**Hyperideal polyhedra in hyperbolic 3-space**

35 pp, 10 sections.

**Abstract.** — A hyperideal polyhedron is a non-compact polyhedron in the hyperbolic 3-space 3 which, in the projective model for 3 ⊂ 3, is just the intersection of 3 with a projective polyhedron whose vertices are all outside 3 and whose edges all meet 3 . We classify hyperideal polyhedra, up to isometries of 3, in terms of their combinatorial type and of their dihedral angles.
